page.overview:
Who is CB?

CB is Lee Revkins' transporter. He is an Aeroliner Semi Haule. He is painted yellow, with the number 63 painted on his doors, and the Transberry Juice logo on his cap. His trailer is purple, with the Transberry Juice logo and number on its sides.

In Cars, CB's trailer is seen at the Motor Speedway of the South, when Mack and McQueen are leaving for their journey to the Los Angeles International Speedway. Category:Cars Characters
